mono.purpose: Tickers, prices, ratios. JetBrains Mono, always right-aligned with tabular-nums.

shadows.name: large

shadows.name: overlay

motion.name: rise-in
motion.purpose: Workhorse entrance for cards, staggered table rows, flag list items.

motion.name: gauge-sweep
motion.purpose: Signature: the composite-score radial gauge, the one longer beat.

motion.name: hover-lift

motion.name: ease-curve
motion.purpose: App-wide single timing curve for every discrete move; shimmer is the one linear carve-out.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Forest-green CTA — the one place solid fill is allowed. FilterDrawer submit, wordmark.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #15803D; color: #FFFFFF; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 2px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 160ms ease-in-out, transform 160ms ease-in-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #166534; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #15803D; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Recommendation Chip
components.description: The canonical outlined-light chip: tinted bg + inset ring + status dot. Never solid-fill. Shown here in the 'lean bullish' emerald tone.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: #ECFDF5; color: #047857; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 2px; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #A7F3D0; } .ds-chip-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #10B981; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Flat surface; a 1px border and a hairline shadow carry depth. 4px radius — never softer on a data surface.

narrative.northStar: Numbers you can read like a ledger
narrative.overview: QuantRank looks and behaves like a well-typeset financial broadsheet, not a software dashboard. The register sits deliberately between a Bloomberg terminal and a printed annual report: dense enough to compare hundreds of stocks at a glance, calm enough that a careful individual investor never feels shouted at. Surfaces are flat; depth comes from crisp 1px borders, not drop shadows. Every number rides a monospaced, right-aligned column so a reader can scan it the way they'd scan a ledger. The personality is Precise, Honest, Editorial — the visual language must never overclaim or celebrate, because the product shows its own limits beside every number.
keyCharacteristics: Flat surfaces; borders carry depth, shadows are reserved for overlays.
Monospaced, right-aligned numerics in every data column (tabular-nums).
One outlined-light chip pattern across the entire app — never solid-fill.
A four-family restrained palette (forest / steel / amber / soft semantic).
Calm by default: motion is an entrance, never a permanent flourish.
Light and dark are first-class; every surface ships a paired dark: variant.

rules.name: The Soft-Band Rule
rules.body: Positive/negative state rides the OKLCH soft band (hue 155 / hue 18, chroma <= 0.10). The 'bright fresh green' and 'alarm red' intensities are forbidden for value state.

rules.name: The Tailwind-Class Rule
rules.body: Reach every color through a Tailwind utility class, never an inline hex. Inline hex bypasses chip-family discipline and is invisible to the purge.

rules.name: The Tabular-Nums Rule
rules.body: Every numeric column gets tabular-nums so digits right-align across rows. Non-negotiable.

rules.name: The Spreadsheet-Header Rule
rules.body: The font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-slate-600 triple is reserved for top-level section h2s and table theads. The weight delta between header and data creates the spreadsheet feel.

rules.name: The Borders-As-Depth Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat. A border, not a shadow, is the default depth cue. Only the Overlay tier appears above the data grid.

dos: Do reach colors through Tailwind utility classes, never an inline hex.
Do put tabular-nums on every numeric column so digits right-align.
Do use the one outlined-light chip pattern (tinted bg + ring + dot) for every chip family.
Do ship a paired dark: variant on every surface; never a light-only card.
Do keep radii <= 4px on data surfaces (2px chips/buttons, 4px cards) and reserve rounded-full for status dots.
Do give every animation a prefers-reduced-motion off-switch and render real values at SSR.
Do let borders carry depth; reserve shadow for overlays.
donts: Don't build a gamified retail-trading feel — no confetti, no dopamine green/red, no celebratory big-number hero, no 'buy now' urgency.
Don't drift toward a generic SaaS-cream dashboard — no cream/sand/beige canvas, no icon + heading + lorem card grids, no uppercase tracked eyebrow above every section.
Don't write hype AI-marketing — no 'supercharge / unleash / next-generation / seamless', no gradient text, no decorative glassmorphism.
Don't ship Bloomberg-terminal overload — dense is fine, an undifferentiated wall of numbers a non-professional can't parse is not.
Don't use a solid fill for a chip — chips are outlined-light only; the one solid-fill exception is the primary CTA button.
Don't use text-green-500 / text-red-600 for value state — use the OKLCH sage/rose soft band.
Don't exceed a 4px radius on cards/inputs, and don't use a colored border-left/right > 1px as a stripe accent.
